ar.title: جرانيتا الليمون

steps.n1: ذوّب السكر في الماء، وأضف قشر الليمون واتركه حتى يغلي على نار هادئة.
steps.n2: اتركه يغلي 10 دقائق مع التقليب من حين لآخر وإزالة الريم حسب الحاجة.
steps.n5: صبّه في قالب ثلج وضعه في الفريزر 60–90 دقيقة.

en.title: Lemon Granita (Granittat al-Lamun)
en.intro: Recipe 446, page 193 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the lemon rind and bring to the boil over a low heat.
steps.n2: Boil for 10 minutes, stirring now and then and skimming as needed.
steps.n5: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.

legacySteps: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the lemon rind and bring to the boil over a low heat.
Boil for 10 minutes, stirring now and then and skimming as needed.
Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.
